scope: Selected official curl and OpenSSL upstream advisories. This is bounded, curated coverage rather than a complete native vulnerability database.
source_precedence: An applicable distribution advisory and full package revision take precedence for a distribution build.
The official upstream vendor advisory takes precedence for a verified upstream release.
Converted or inferred feed ranges are retained as conflicts and never silently override the applicable vendor source.

advisories.title: SOCKS5 heap buffer overflow
advisories.affectedness_evidence: The official curl advisory identifies 8.4.0 as the fixed release for the affected 8.3.0 benchmark boundary.
advisories.reachability_note: Requires SOCKS5 remote hostname resolution, a long hostname and a slow handshake. The heap overflow also depends on an effective download buffer below 65541 bytes.

advisories.title: Cookie injection through duplicated easy handles
advisories.affectedness_evidence: The official curl advisory identifies 8.4.0 as the fixed release for the affected 8.3.0 benchmark boundary.
advisories.reachability_note: The vulnerable behavior is in the libcurl easy-handle cookie API and is not available through the curl command-line program alone.

conflicting_sources.name: OSV converted Git range
conflicting_sources.resolution: Retained as a conflict. For the verified upstream 8.4.0 release, the official curl fixed-version statement is selected.

advisories.title: Mixed-case cookie public suffix bypass
advisories.affectedness_evidence: The official curl advisory identifies 8.5.0 as the fixed release; the curated 8.3.0 and 8.4.0 boundaries remain affected.
advisories.reachability_note: Product exposure depends on libcurl cookie handling and Public Suffix List support.

advisories.title: TLS and DTLS heartbeat information disclosure
advisories.affectedness_evidence: The official OpenSSL advisory identifies 1.0.1g as the corrected release for the curated 1.0.1f boundary.
advisories.reachability_note: Requires the heartbeat implementation in the deployed build and a reachable TLS or DTLS peer. OPENSSL_NO_HEARTBEATS can remove the feature.

advisories.title: ChangeCipherSpec man-in-the-middle weakness
advisories.affectedness_evidence: The official OpenSSL advisory identifies 1.0.1h as the corrected release; the curated 1.0.1f and 1.0.1g boundaries precede that fix.
advisories.reachability_note: Successful exploitation requires vulnerable OpenSSL peers on both sides of the connection.

advisories.title: DTLS fragment buffer overflow
advisories.affectedness_evidence: The official OpenSSL advisory identifies 1.0.1h as the corrected release; the curated 1.0.1f and 1.0.1g boundaries precede that fix.
advisories.reachability_note: The vulnerable behavior is in DTLS. A TLS-only deployment does not establish reachability.
